spokenMeaning: The post nearly goes out, then is erased again out of fear of judgment and gossip.
viewerTakeaway: Your own hand un-sends the post: each finished line is pulled back into the caret until nothing is left to send.

visualNarrative.action: Headline band top-left fades in: 'POSTING SESUATU… HAPUS LAGI.' with the quiet sub-line 'Takut ada yang ngejudge.'; beneath it a hollow draft card sits alone in the center band, one gold caret blinking at its first line.
visualNarrative.meaning: Sets the ritual before it happens: the intention to post exists, uncommitted.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Headline block locked to the 8% left/top margin, card centered below with clear band separation; no element crosses into another band.

visualNarrative.action: Four text lines type into the card one by one, the gold '99%' counter landing flush against the card's lower-right terminus as the card fill brightens.
visualNarrative.meaning: The post is essentially ready — near-complete content reads instantly as 'about to go out'.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Lines revealed by stagger draw; 99% optically sized to card height and welded to the bar terminus, never floating in a corner.

visualNarrative.action: A two-beat hold at 99%: only the caret blinks once, nothing else moves — hesitation visible as stillness.
visualNarrative.meaning: The fear arrives in the gap between finishing and sending.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Frame static except one soft blink of the gold caret; card and lines motionless.

visualNarrative.action: Each line retracts back into the caret from bottom to top — text un-typing itself — while the counter runs 99 → 54 → 12 → 0 and the card dims to a hollow outline.
visualNarrative.meaning: Regression: the act visibly un-sends itself — 'hapus lagi' shown as reverse typing, not repetition.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Line 4 pulls into the caret first, then 3, 2, 1; counter lands on 0%; card returns to dim outline.

visualNarrative.action: Two fear labels fade in stacked 24px apart in their own lower band: 'NGEJUDGE' over 'NGOMONGIN'; a hairline separates them from 'Nggak jadi terkirim.' in the bottom band.
visualNarrative.meaning: Names the two fears that caused the retraction without illustrating them literally.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Labels stacked with fixed 24px gap, closing line past a hairline in its own band — no text overlaps anywhere.

semanticObjects.relationship: Appears only after the card is hollow, stacked below it with a fixed gap.

compositionIntent: split bands: headline top-left at 8% margins, hollow draft card as the single dominant object in the center band with its counter welded to the terminus, fear labels stacked in a lower band with a fixed 24px gap, closing line past a hairline at the bottom. One text block plus one object, ~65% negative space, strictly banded so no cross-anchor overlap.
visualEvidence: Gold 99% sits flush at the card terminus, optically matched to the card's height — never floating in a corner.
Lines un-type into the caret while the counter lands on 0% — the drain is visible as change.
Fear labels stack with a fixed 24px gap; the closing line sits in a clear band beneath a hairline.
Only one accent (gold) appears; card outline, caret rail, and hairline use secondary #B5B1A7.
forbiddenInterpretations: No looping upload/retry animation — this is a one-way retraction, not a cycle.
No phone mockup, social-media UI, notification icons, or trash-can/delete button.
No teal plus gold together — gold is the only accent in this scene.
No crowd of judging faces, pointing arrows, or floating speech bubbles.
No leftTextRightObject repeat of scene_03, no stray vertical line across the counter, no countdown clock, glitch, or particle burst on the erasure.
noveltyIntent: Instead of dissolving lines, the post un-types itself: each line is pulled back into a single gold caret while the counter welded to the card terminus drains to 0 — self-cancellation happens as reverse typing inside the content, not in a UI widget.
